dict.string: Casement shows your next event in the notch and a Join button for video calls. Events never leave your Mac.
Casement shows your next event in the notch. Events never leave your Mac.
Casement can show reminders that are due soon. Reminders never leave your Mac.
Casement shows download progress in the notch. It reads file names and sizes only.
Casement shows the weather where you are, when you choose that in Settings. Only a rounded position is sent to the forecast service.
Casement shows the weather where you are, when you choose that in Settings. Only a rounded position is sent to the forecast service.

Casement listens on your local network so Shortcuts on your iPhone can put something in the notch. This is off until you turn on the iPhone bridge in Settings, and nothing is sent outside your network.
Casement shows your camera on the Mirror page, for a quick look before a call. The camera is on only while that page is open, and nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
Casement controls Music or Spotify (play, pause, skip) when you use the media controls in the notch.
